meta.title: Improved prefix caching for paged attention
meta.body_summary: Fix LogicalTokenBlock::pop_token to keep block size constant and re-enable paged prefix caching, which was previously disabled.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex-authored PR to fix pop_token and re-enable paged prefix caching; still open as draft, no formal reviews, a user asks about implementation status and OOMs.

core_change_summary.description: Fix LogicalTokenBlock::pop_token to set the last token to zero rather than removing it, and re-enable paged prefix caching in PrefixCacheManagerV2 with block reference counting and cache insertion logic.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Sequence and inputs_processor changes may be indirectly related to supporting the cache re-enablement.
